text:
nina (Product): Quick design check: finalizing SLO presets + burst scheduling in Capacity modal. Figma: https://figma.redwood/capacity-presets. Need keyboard/a11y + copy review.
li (Design): Proposal: three presets above the slider: Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive. Short desc under each. Keep compact row on mobile.
rahul (Frontend): Keyboard rules: arrow to nudge, shift+arrow fine tune, Home/End to min/max, double-click to type value. Slider should expose role="slider" and aria-valuetext like "SLO target: 120 ms".
maya (Engineering): Backend note: preview API can estimate instance-hours; debounce UI changes 300ms, only call preview on commit or pause. Guardrail: show a soft warning for very aggressive settings.
li (Design): Copy for burst: change "Burst" to "Temporary capacity"; CTA: "Add temporary capacity" with quick presets 15m/30m/1h. Tooltip: "Billed while active."
a11y-bot: Checklist: 1) Slider announces changes via aria-live when adjusted, 2) Focus order: presets -> slider -> numeric input -> burst -> apply, 3) Ensure contrast on preset pills >=4.5:1.
rahul (Frontend): Accessibility detail: announce when burst starts/stops. Make disabled min/max visible but aria-disabled and explanatory tooltip when autoscale on.
maya (Engineering): Telemetry: track preset chosen, manual edit, burst scheduled, and save-default click. Per-pool defaults are blocked for now (API follow-up).
nina (Product): Decisions: keep presets, add quick burst presets, show cost-preview banner for large changes, include disabled "Save as pool default" checkbox (tooltip: Coming soon). Li will update Figma; Rahul/Maya implement.
li (Design): I'll push updated frames by EOD and annotate keyboard flows.
rahul (Frontend): I'll add stories + axe checks.
maya (Engineering): I'll scope preview API and migration for defaults.
nina (Product): Thanks all — aiming to ship next week if no blockers. :rocket:
